description: This file contains C++ source code defining classes and functions for testing a cyclic buffer implementation, including thread classes, file-based buffer access, inter-process synchronization, and process management for stress testing the cyclic buffer.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: A thread class that holds a buffer of Lorem Ipsum text and provides validation functionality.

classes.name: Reader
classes.description: A class for reading from a cyclic buffer, with file-based storage, supporting multiple reserved blocks.

classes.name: Writer
classes.description: A class for writing to a cyclic buffer, with file-based storage, supporting multiple reserved blocks.

classes.name: BufferCreator
classes.description: A template class to create and manage a cyclic buffer with specified size and reserved blocks.

classes.name: BufferUsers
classes.description: A template class managing multiple reader and writer instances for a cyclic buffer.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: A template class managing process creation, inter-process synchronization, and cyclic buffer access for stress testing.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the data buffer against a reference pattern.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns the current status of the thread.

methods.name: Worker
methods.description: Main thread loop performing cyclic buffer read/write operations.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables the buffer or thread for operation.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the buffer or thread is enabled.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the buffer or thread has encountered an error.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the cyclic buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the cyclic buffer.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the thread or buffer operation.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the thread or buffer operation.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes the process logic, including forking and synchronization.

methods.name: SetChildUsers
methods.description: Configures the number of child process users.

methods.name: SetParentUsers
methods.description: Configures the number of parent process users.

methods.name: SetTotalRuntime
methods.description: Sets the total runtime for the process.

methods.name: SetAllowedSetupTime
methods.description: Sets the setup time for process initialization.

methods.name: SetNumReservedBlocks
methods.description: Sets the number of reserved blocks for cyclic buffer.
